items.description: Windows features installation — install all 13 features (Hyper-V, BitLocker, HostGuardian, RSAT-Shielded-VM-Tools, RSAT-Hyper-V-Tools, Hyper-V-Tools, Hyper-V-PowerShell, Failover-Clustering, RSAT-Clustering-PowerShell, FS-FileServer, NetworkVirtualization, RSAT-Clustering-Mgmt, Data-Center-Bridging) with include_sub_features; notify reboot handler

items.description: Hyper-V virtual switch creation — create external vSwitch 'OS-Traffic' on NIC1 with SET enabled using ansible.windows.win_shell (New-VMSwitch); must run after reboot post-feature-install; includes idempotency guard (Get-VMSwitch check)
items.notes: Converted xVMSwitch DSC resource to win_shell with New-VMSwitch, NIC pre-flight check, and verification

items.description: Molecule scenario configuration — delegated driver, local connection (not docker/podman)

Molecule converge playbook — creates expected filesystem state under /tmp/molecule_test/ (admin_path directory present, api_folder_path absent); exercises base_os, windows_features, domain_join, vswitch tasks
items.notes: Generated converge.yml: creates /tmp/molecule_test/ scaffold with admin dir, absent API folder, simulated UAC/ExecutionPolicy registry files, features manifest, and vSwitch config placeholder. All loops use loop_control with prefixed loop_var and bracket notation.

items.description: Molecule verify playbook — checks /tmp/molecule_test/ paths: admin_path directory exists, api_folder_path absent, UAC registry keys set, execution policy registry key set, vmms/HvHost services running, OS-Traffic vSwitch present with SET enabled, domain membership correct
items.notes: Generated verify.yml split into 3 plays: Play 1 (directory/file existence via stat+assert), Play 2 (file content via slurp+assert for UAC values, ExecutionPolicy, features manifest, vSwitch config), Play 3 (Windows-only checks tagged molecule-notest: NIC1, vmms/HvHost services, vSwitch, win_feature, domain membership, registry values).
